description: Java utility class for parsing Java source files, identifying method blocks, service calls, entity uses, and stripping comments.

classes.name: UtilJavaParse
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for parsing Java source files, including locating class files, method blocks, service calls, entity uses, and comment stripping.

methods.name: findRealPathAndFileForClass
methods.description: Locates the source file path for a given fully qualified class name by searching component directories.

methods.name: findServiceMethodBlockStart
methods.description: Finds the start position of a specified service method block within a Java source file.

methods.name: findEndOfBlock
methods.description: Recursively finds the end position of a code block starting from a given position.

methods.name: findServiceCallsInBlock
methods.description: Extracts service call names within a specified code block.

methods.name: findEntityUseInBlock
methods.description: Extracts entity usage names within a specified code block.

methods.name: stripComments
methods.description: Removes block and line comments from Java source code.
